questions.question: Which direction should we pursue next?

options.label: Alerting maturity (Recommended)
options.description: Cooldown windows, escalation policies, and test-notification button. Biggest operator pain point — alerts currently fire but have no lifecycle.

options.label: Audit trail viewer
options.description: Admin-only UI to browse user actions with filtering. Quick win — data already exists in log files.

options.label: Kiosk runtime testing
options.description: Actually run the WPF kiosk, verify policy enforcement and navigation guards work end-to-end.

options.label: Production packaging
options.description: Publish single-file EXEs, MSI installers, Docker images for real deployment.
